title: Fosavance (alendronic acid/colecalciferol) tablets: summary of product characteristics, EPAR product information
authors: European Medicines Agency, Committee for Medicinal Products for Human Use
journal: European Medicines Agency; marketing authorisation EU/1/05/310, first authorised 24 August 2005, renewed 24 April 2015; product information document of 10 February 2026
funder: not stated; EU product information carries no funding statement.
result: Colecalciferol component (2800 or 5600 IU weekly): vitamin D3 may increase the magnitude of hypercalcaemia and/or hypercalciuria when given to patients with diseases associated with unregulated overproduction of calcitriol (for example leukaemia, lymphoma, sarcoidosis); urine and serum calcium should be monitored in these patients. The content of vitamin D is not suitable for correction of vitamin D deficiency. Anticonvulsants, cimetidine and thiazides may increase the catabolism of vitamin D. Overdose section: vitamin D toxicity has not been documented during chronic therapy in generally healthy adults at doses below 10,000 IU/day. Pharmacokinetics: the mean serum half-life of vitamin D3 after a 2800 IU dose is about 24 hours; after radioactive vitamin D3, urinary excretion was 2.4% at 48 hours and faecal excretion 4.9% at 4 days, almost exclusively as metabolites.
